title: Standardize live-region patterns and role mapping for compact panels (VPAT evidence)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Compact panels (small side panels, inline detail cards and dense toolbars) currently implement inconsistent ARIA patterns: some use aria-live, others rely on role=region with no polite/assertive semantics, and a few use aria-roledescription inconsistently. Screen reader announcements and focus transfer behavior vary across products and have caused support tickets for missed confirmations and unclear state changes. We need a durable, testable pattern documented and implemented across tokens + components, plus VPAT-grade evidence for certification.

Scope: compact panels, dense toolbar buttons, mini-chart annotations and data-grid row expansion panels. Excludes modals and full-screen dialogs.

Deliverables: a concise pattern guideline in the design system (live-region semantics + examples), updated design tokens for focus/contrast in compact densities, PRs that update the Panel/Toolbar/Button components, Storybook examples with axe snapshots, automated e2e checks for screen-reader-friendly announcements, and a VPAT annex containing screenshots, test scripts, and results for affected components.
acceptance_criteria: Pattern doc published in Design System space with examples and rationale
Compact panels expose aria-live or aria-atomic consistently per flow (polite for non-critical, assertive for immediate confirmations)
Role mapping (region / complementary / status / alert) defined and applied; no use of nonstandard role substitutions
Design tokens updated: focus ring thickness/color and token contrast values validated against WCAG AA for compact densities
All updated components (Panel, CompactToolbar, CompactButton, MiniChartTooltip) merge with green CI and Storybook axe snapshots pass
VPAT annex created with reproducible test steps, screen reader transcripts, and screenshots demonstrating fix; added to release artifacts
comments: 2026-03-05: Triage meeting notes — identified pattern mismatch across 4 product surfaces; recommended short-term fallback (announce via existing toast system) and long-term pattern work. Assigned to Elliot.

2026-03-07: Design proposal drafted (link below). Proposal prefers aria-live="polite" for non-blocking annotations and aria-live="assertive" only for destructive confirmations. Includes mapping table from UX intent -> ARIA role/attribute.

2026-03-09: Engineering review (Miguel Santos) — called out implementation constraints: continuous updates to mini-charts must be debounced to avoid announcement spam. Suggested adding a debounce util and a config prop on Panel: liveMode = {auto|manual|off}.

2026-03-11: Accessibility review (Monica Zhang, a11y consultant) — asked for clear deterministic tests with VoiceOver and NVDA transcripts, and for color token ranges to be verified against 3:1 for UI components and 4.5:1 for text per compact density guidance.
2026-03-13: Design -> dev handoff completed. Tokens spreadsheet updated with new focus token names (focus-compact-1 / focus-compact-2). PRs opened for Panel + CompactToolbar (links below).
2026-03-15: QA notes — initial Storybook axe run shows two contrast failures in CompactButton secondary state; design iterating on token swap. Preparing VPAT annex skeleton for internal review.
